_comment: Drives compare.html. To turn any third-party dataset cell into a live 3D viewer, set its `mesh` to a relative path of an STL you have CONFIRMED you may redistribute, and add the matching entry to THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md. Leave `mesh` null to keep a link-out card. Nothing here under a third-party `name` is CC0 — see THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md.

cadquarry.name: CadQuarry
cadquarry.parametric: Yes — every part is a PARAMS schema + build(p) function
cadquarry.provenance: Generated from scratch, reproducible bit-for-bit from a seed
cadquarry.redistributable: Yes — public domain, no attribution required

datasets.name: ABC Dataset
datasets.parametric: No — B-rep solids only, no parametric program
datasets.redistributable: Inconsistent — each model keeps its original Onshape author license
datasets.note: There is no single dataset-wide license: individual models retain whatever license their original Onshape author chose, so a blanket 'redistribute' grant does not exist.

datasets.name: DeepCAD
datasets.parametric: Construction sequences (sketch + extrude commands), not free-parameter schemas
datasets.redistributable: Code is MIT; the underlying geometry inherits ABC/Onshape provenance
datasets.note: The MIT license covers the modeling/learning code. The shapes themselves come from ABC, so their redistribution rights are ABC's, not MIT.

datasets.name: Fusion 360 Gallery
datasets.provenance: User designs from the Autodesk Online Gallery
datasets.redistributable: No — Autodesk research license restricts redistribution
datasets.note: Distributed under an Autodesk research license that does not grant re-hosting of the models.

datasets.name: Thingi10K
datasets.redistributable: Per-model: a mix of CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC BY-NC, CC BY-ND and all-rights-reserved
datasets.note: Some models forbid derivatives (ND) or any reuse; you must check each model's individual Thingiverse license before re-hosting it.

datasets.name: ShapeNet
datasets.redistributable: No — terms require registration and forbid re-hosting
datasets.note: Access is gated behind a signed agreement; the terms of use explicitly prohibit redistribution, so no sample can be shown here even for demonstration.
